posts.text:
Be Kind
Extend Grace 
Love Thy Neighbor

Video

In a time when cruelty and crassness;
meanness and mercilessness;
seem to command the spotlight,

let’s not forget:

Our world is still filled with goodness.
With quiet courage.
With helpers, healers, and everyday heroes.

They may not trend,
but they transform lives.

We need more of that.
And more importantly…
we must be more of that.

Video

The Trump Administration is at war with science, evidence and truth.

Video

Trump and other Republicans are actively working to undermine free and fair elections -  right ahead of the midterm elections.

However, we are not powerless. There is a movement of people fighting back and often winning. 

I am grateful for the Brennan Center and so many others who are standing for democracy, fairness and justice. 

We must continue the work. 

OP: @brennancenter

Video

I found this to be so beautiful.

Video

The power of kindness.

Video

I introduced new legislation to review and unwind the anti-competitive corporate mergers rushed through under the Trump administration. 

This bill will help reverse dangerous media consolidation and restore competition. 

Let this be clear: those who break our laws or ignore them to appease Donald Trump should be held accountable.

Video

This is what happens when we let vanity and ego drive our government. $400 million in taxpayer dollars for Trump's vanity projects? While families struggle with housing, healthcare, and the cost of living? 

We can—and must—do better.

OP: @senatebudget

Video

I will continue to fight against the chemical companies that are poisoning people for profits. The companies that pour millions into lobbying Congress for exemptions from liability. And I will fight against the Trump administration that is siding with these corporations against people. 

Unbelievably, before the Supreme Court, the Trump administration is siding with Bayer against the people suffering cancers and other devastating health outcomes linked to Monsanto’s glyphosate product, Roundup.

This was a great victory this week. House Republicans moved to stop chemical company liability by giving them an immunity shield. 

The people fought back and the language got stripped. 

I will continue to lead and fight in The Senate against the corporations and their lobbyists that want to prevent people from having the legal ability to fight the companies that poison us.

OP: @thefoodbabe

Video

This is sad and unacceptable for people who want to serve on our judiciary

There is nothing more powerful than what we can achieve when we come together as one team.

You are worthy

You are loved

The Trump administration is again trying to silence voices it disagrees with. Jimmy Kimmel and others should not be subject to the whims of this, or any, president.

Video

The Supreme Court’s recent decision means the stakes of this election have risen. It has to be a movement election to protect our democratic rights.

Video

"Having a kind heart in a cruel world is not a weakness, it is a superpower."

Video

This is the power of seeing potential instead of disruption. 
We need to celebrate our kids' imaginations and lift up their dreams. 
Credit: @andyyjiang_

Video

Instead of wasting millions in taxpayer dollars on politically motivated prosecutions against Trump's enemies, the Justice Department should focus on keeping Americans safe.

This is more of President Trump's chaos, cruelty and rising costs for Americans.

Video

$25 billion of American taxpayer dollars—and counting—have been spent on conflict with Iran. 

This isn't just numbers on a ledger. It's our children's futures, our infrastructure, our ability to lift up the vulnerable. 

We need to end this war and start spending our money here at home. 

Credit: @phillydefranco

Video

The Supreme Court's decision is a brutal blow to our highest ideals of our democracy: fair elections and fair representation. 

This is a movement moment. In generations past, when equal representation was eviscerated across the south. A movement rose up to end the anti-democratic, vote suppressing, illegitimate maps and tactics. 

This is what we need to do now. 

Op: @jesscraven101
